provides.label: MRtrix3 SIFT2 独立流线赋权
provides.description:
独立调用 MRtrix3 3.0.8 的 tcksift2；保留原软件计算，参数按原版本帮助定义。

Optimise per-streamline cross-section multipliers to match a whole-brain tractogram to fixel-wise fibre densities

input_slots.label: in_fod
input_slots.description: input image containing the spherical harmonics of the fibre orientation distributions

input_slots.label: 处理权重掩膜
input_slots.description: provide an image containing the processing mask weights for the model; image spatial dimensions must match the fixel image

input_slots.label: ACT 五组织影像
input_slots.description: use an ACT five-tissue-type segmented anatomical image to derive the processing mask

output_slots.label: 输出：SIFT2 独立流线赋权
output_slots.description: output text file containing the weighting factor for each streamline 文件名由平台固定在本次输出目录内。

output_slots.label: csv
output_slots.description: output statistics of execution per iteration to a .csv file

output_slots.label: out_mu
output_slots.description: output the final value of SIFT proportionality coefficient mu to a text file

output_slots.label: out_coeffs
output_slots.description: output text file containing the weighting coefficient for each streamline

parameters.label: 结合 ACT 缩放灰质纤维密度
parameters.description: provide this option (in conjunction with -act) to heuristically downsize the fibre density estimates based on the presence of GM in the voxel. This can assist in reducing tissue interface effects when using a single-tissue deconvolution algorithm
parameters.condition_help: 启用后必须提供 ACT 5TT 影像；不会自动生成 5TT。

parameters.label: no_dilate_lut
parameters.description: do NOT dilate FOD lobe lookup tables; only map streamlines to FOD lobes if the precise tangent lies within the angular spread of that lobe

parameters.label: make_null_lobes
parameters.description: add an additional FOD lobe to each voxel, with zero integral, that covers all directions with zero / negative FOD amplitudes

parameters.label: remove_untracked
parameters.description: remove FOD lobes that do not have any streamline density attributed to them; this improves filtering slightly, at the expense of longer computation time (and you can no longer do quantitative comparisons between reconstructions if this is enabled)

parameters.label: fd_thresh
parameters.description: fibre density threshold; exclude an FOD lobe from filtering processing if its integral is less than this amount (streamlines will still be mapped to it, but it will not contribute to the cost function or the filtering)
parameters.software_default: 未设置时不传入该选项；默认行为以 MRtrix3 3.0.8 原始说明为准。

parameters.label: 保存 csv
parameters.description: output statistics of execution per iteration to a .csv file

parameters.label: 保存 out_mu
parameters.description: output the final value of SIFT proportionality coefficient mu to a text file

parameters.label: 保存 out_coeffs
parameters.description: output text file containing the weighting coefficient for each streamline

parameters.label: Tikhonov 正则化系数
parameters.description: provide coefficient for regularising streamline weighting coefficients (Tikhonov regularisation) (default: 0)
parameters.software_default: 未设置时不传入该选项；默认行为以 MRtrix3 3.0.8 原始说明为准。

parameters.label: 总变分正则化系数
parameters.description: provide coefficient for regularising variance of streamline weighting coefficient to fixels along its length (Total Variation regularisation) (default: 0.1)
parameters.software_default: 未设置时不传入该选项；默认行为以 MRtrix3 3.0.8 原始说明为准。

parameters.label: min_td_frac
parameters.description: minimum fraction of the FOD integral reconstructed by streamlines; if the reconstructed streamline density is below this fraction, the fixel is excluded from optimisation (default: 0.1)
parameters.software_default: 未设置时不传入该选项；默认行为以 MRtrix3 3.0.8 原始说明为准。

parameters.label: 最少迭代次数
parameters.description: minimum number of iterations to run before testing for convergence; this can prevent premature termination at early iterations if the cost function increases slightly (default: 10)
parameters.software_default: 未设置时不传入该选项；默认行为以 MRtrix3 3.0.8 原始说明为准。

parameters.label: 最多迭代次数
parameters.description: maximum number of iterations to run before terminating program
parameters.software_default: 未设置时不传入该选项；默认行为以 MRtrix3 3.0.8 原始说明为准。

parameters.label: 最小流线权重
parameters.description: minimum weighting factor for an individual streamline; if the factor falls below this number the streamline will be rejected entirely (factor set to zero) (default: 0)
parameters.software_default: 未设置时不传入该选项；默认行为以 MRtrix3 3.0.8 原始说明为准。

parameters.label: 最小对数系数
parameters.description: minimum weighting coefficient for an individual streamline; similar to the '-min_factor' option, but using the exponential coefficient basis of the SIFT2 model; these parameters are related as: factor = e^(coeff). Note that the -min_factor and -min_coeff options are mutually exclusive - you can only provide one. (default: -inf)
parameters.software_default: 未设置时不传入该选项；默认行为以 MRtrix3 3.0.8 原始说明为准。

parameters.label: 最大流线权重
parameters.description: maximum weighting factor that can be assigned to any one streamline (default: inf)
parameters.software_default: 未设置时不传入该选项；默认行为以 MRtrix3 3.0.8 原始说明为准。

parameters.label: 最大对数系数
parameters.description: maximum weighting coefficient for an individual streamline; similar to the '-max_factor' option, but using the exponential coefficient basis of the SIFT2 model; these parameters are related as: factor = e^(coeff). Note that the -max_factor and -max_coeff options are mutually exclusive - you can only provide one. (default: inf)
parameters.software_default: 未设置时不传入该选项；默认行为以 MRtrix3 3.0.8 原始说明为准。

parameters.label: max_coeff_step
parameters.description: maximum change to a streamline's weighting coefficient in a single iteration (default: 1)
parameters.software_default: 未设置时不传入该选项；默认行为以 MRtrix3 3.0.8 原始说明为准。

parameters.label: min_cf_decrease
parameters.description: minimum decrease in the cost function (as a fraction of the initial value) that must occur each iteration for the algorithm to continue (default: 2.5e-05)
parameters.software_default: 未设置时不传入该选项；默认行为以 MRtrix3 3.0.8 原始说明为准。

parameters.label: linear
parameters.description: perform a linear estimation of streamline weights, rather than the standard non-linear optimisation (typically does not provide as accurate a model fit; but only requires a single pass)

parameters.label: info
parameters.description: display information messages.

parameters.label: quiet
parameters.description: do not display information messages or progress status; alternatively, this can be achieved by setting the MRTRIX_QUIET environment variable to a non-empty string.

parameters.label: debug
parameters.description: display debugging messages.

parameters.label: CPU 线程数
parameters.description: use this number of threads in multi-threaded applications (set to 0 to disable multi-threading).
parameters.software_default: 未设置时不传入该选项；默认行为以 MRtrix3 3.0.8 原始说明为准。
